rust_summary: context-free tag lookups for server hooks (`native_server_block_in_tag`, `native_server_item_in_tag`).
doc_summary: context-free block and item tag lookups from server hooks (`native_server_block_in_tag`, `native_server_item_in_tag`). They return `NotServer` on a client and `TagsUnavailable` before the world loads its tags. An unknown tag returns false; an empty stack tests `minecraft:air`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_tag_reads@.
